slides.headline: Chucho Valdés at the Arsht Center
slides.body: Saturday, Oct. 3 at 8 p.m. at the Adrienne Arsht Center in Miami. Tickets are $52 to $158. The show marks his 85th birthday and includes Joe Lovano and Terence Blanchard.

slides.headline: Absolute Bands Live! in Aventura
slides.body: Saturday, Oct. 3 at 3 p.m. and 7 p.m. at Aventura Arts & Cultural Center in Aventura. Tickets are $45 to $71. The setlist leans on Queen, Journey, Def Leppard, and Bon Jovi.

slides.body: Open this week at Superblue Miami in Miami. Admission requires a complimentary on-site reservation, first come, first served. The room-sized installation uses shifting fields of color.
